title: My best month almost killed my bakery
caption:
"December was the best month my bakery ever had. And it almost closed me."

November: she stocks up. Flour, butter, boxes, all paid upfront.
December: lines out the door, plus three big catering orders on invoice.
January: the shop goes quiet, the catering money still hasn't landed, and payroll is due.

She wasn't losing money. She ran out of it at the wrong time.

Has a great month ever left you short the month after? 👇
